seed_city_body: A harbor on the cliffs. Its bell only rings at low tide, but last night it rang three times as the water rose.
seed_hero_body: A cursed bloodline. The black dragon left him on the bell tower and flew away alone.
seed_elena_body: The missing scholar's daughter. She hands you a water-level record and whispers: Don't trust her.
seed_cathedral_body: The seat of the church. Construction continues underground. The final tide-table entry reads: Press the scales.
seed_dragon_body: A guide, never a fighter. It watches the cliffs as if recognizing an old friend.
seed_clue_body: The last unusual low tide was six days ago. Someone wrote this number beside the record.
suggest_secret_body: Leave a subtle clue pointing to a choice made long ago.
suggest_voice_body: Write the words they most want to say but have kept to themselves.
suggest_next_body: Change one established fact and follow its consequences through the world.

dialogue_intro: New places, people and clues return to the same board beside you.
dialogue_restart_note: A new run keeps everything already discovered.
dialogue_start_line: In the nave, Elena slips you a paper. “Don’t trust the cardinal. My father is still down there.”
dialogue_note_line: “Thirty-seven went down six days ago. Father was last. Tonight they call the thirty-eighth.”
dialogue_father_line: “My father is Oran. He went below to measure the water without his glasses. He didn’t leave willingly.”
dialogue_marcus_line: Marcus takes Elena’s arm. “At the altar, on the twelfth bell.” She whispers, “The crypt opens when the bell strikes twelve.”
dialogue_crypt_line: At the stone door an acolyte blocks you. “My brother was among those thirty-seven. Are you looking for them?”
dialogue_slope_line: “Take the side passage.” The acolyte steps aside. Dragon ash coats the walls; the passage winds behind the altar.
dialogue_bell_line: The keeper rests a hand on the bell. “I didn’t ring it. Something below knocks against it, like a heartbeat.”
dialogue_end_line: The twelfth bell. Veronica takes the altar. Marcus brings Elena before her. “The thirty-eighth.” All paths meet here.
dialogue_miss: “Stay with this. The twelfth bell is almost here.” Ask again, or choose the next step.
place_crypt_body: A stone door carved with scales glows red through its cracks. It opens from the nave when the ritual begins.
place_slope_body: The acolyte opens a side door. Dragon ash coats warm walls; the exit lies behind the altar.
place_bell_body: The keeper has rung it for thirty years. Now it rings by itself, with a slow heartbeat inside.
guard_body: Guards the seal door, hands covered in dragon ash. His brother is among the missing.
bellringer_body: Rings the church bell, but admits last night it rang without him.
clue_ritual_body: Thirty-seven went below and never returned. The midnight ritual calls the thirty-eighth.
scene_body: Scene definition saved: place, cast, clues and discoveries from this run. Panoramic play comes later.
